Title: As a viewer, I want to produce a building card image to include in presentations.
As an admin, I want to set municipality user permissions to view/edit/can’t access so that system access is controlled.
As an admin, I want users to log in with 2FA so that only authorized people can use the system.
As an editor, I want status/data to sync with external municipality systems so that data remains consistent across systems.
As an admin, I want a clear role model (Viewer, User–Editor, Admin) so that access and responsibilities are unambiguous.
As a viewer, I want to open a building page/card with photos so that I can understand the property at a glance.

As a municipality staff user (admin/editor), I want to export the buildings table (optionally with current filters) to an Excel file, so that I can keep a backup of the database locally, and restore it later via “import from excel”.
As an editor, I want to update existing buildings so that errors and changes are reflected promptly.
As a viewer, I want to view building details so that I can review its current status.
As a viewer, I want to view a building’s change log so that I can understand its history.
As a viewer, I want to search and filter logs so that I can locate specific events quickly.
As an editor, I want to add new buildings so that the database stays current.
As a viewer, I want a full audit trail of who changed what and when so that compliance requirements are met.
As a viewer, I want to search and filter buildings (street, house no., nickname, status/category, area) so that I can quickly find relevant records.
As an editor, I want to remove buildings (with safeguards) so that obsolete or duplicate entries are cleaned up.
As an admin, I want to delete log entries so that sensitive or erroneous logs can be corrected while preserving accountability.
As an editor, I want to add or edit log entries for a building so that important actions are recorded.
